Report system is broken
11 Oct @ 8:45am
Naktre
The reporting system in Dota 2 is seriously flawed. Anyone can report anyone, regardless of whether they actually did anything wrong.

The biggest problem is when players queue together.
Valve needs a better system that distinguishes actual misconduct from false and coordinated reports.

Players shouldn't be punished just because a group decides to target them.

The fundamental flaw in automated reporting: Why raw report counts fail Dota 2

Claiming the system works simply because it "feels friendlier" ignores a major structural flaw: the automated system relies entirely on post-game report volume rather than context or intent verification.


We don't need a "wild wild west"—we need accountability. Valve needs weighted report trust scores (penalizing false reporters and bots greifing) and automated verification before stripping communication features from players trying to play the game.

anti false report methods
4 Mar, 2015 @ 7:15pm
Karmac
Because dota 2 doesn't have a summoner code to prevent unethical behavior, i think a great way to combat false reports would be this

A report is invalidated if:

the team wins the game ( winning solves everything, what could a person do wrong if it didn't cost you the game? )

The person has the highest gold per minute on team ( getting gold shows skill )
The Person has the highest KDR ( they must have been contributing if they were killing the enemy most )
The person has the highest Experience per minute ( They must have been showing up to all team fights and always being active )

Any of those things will null all reports for that game. this will really cut down on report abuse. and if you do report someone when your team wins you actually get the report counted towards yourself ( to further reduce report abuse )

What do you guys think, please don't troll and stay on topic
